config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  pre key.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() <= text.char_count()
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  ex config_value("a=1", "z") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    var k = ""
    var v = ""
    var n = 0
    for p in line.split("=")
      if n == 0
        k = p.copy()
      else
        if n > 1
          v += "="
        v += p
      n += 1
    if n > 1 and k == key
      return v
  ""
